meta.descripcion: Procesa el buffer de una conversación: toma el lock ANTES de leer nada, arma el contexto (prompt 3 capas + historial), llama al modelo con las herramientas de agent/tools.json, ejecuta a lo sumo una herramienta, cierra con una segunda pasada del modelo, manda la respuesta, registra el run y libera el lock. Fallback ante error del modelo: avisa y deriva a un humano.
meta.notas: Los nodos Postgres usan typeVersion 2.6 con options.queryReplacement como array (evita el split por coma). __AGENT_TOOLS__ lo reemplaza setup.js por el array agent/tools.json.tools. La segunda pasada del modelo narra el resultado de la herramienta en texto plano (no usa bloques tool_result nativos) para no depender del formato de cada proveedor. 'Modelo · Llamar' y 'Modelo · Llamar 2' reintentan 4 veces con 3 s de espera y timeout de 45 s: el free tier de Gemini tira 503 'high demand' de forma intermitente. 'Registrar run' referencia 'Modelo · Normalizar' con guard .isExecuted porque ese nodo no corre en la rama de fallback.

parameters.query:
WITH cli AS (
  INSERT INTO clients (phone) VALUES ($1)
  ON CONFLICT (phone) DO UPDATE SET updated_at = now()
  RETURNING id, phone, name, opted_out, consent_shown_at
),
conv AS (
  INSERT INTO conversations (client_id, phone)
  SELECT id, phone FROM cli
  ON CONFLICT (client_id) DO UPDATE SET last_message_at = now()
  RETURNING id, state, summary
),
hist AS (
  SELECT json_agg(x ORDER BY x.created_at) AS items FROM (
    SELECT m.direction, m.content, m.created_at
    FROM messages m JOIN conv ON conv.id = m.conversation_id
    ORDER BY m.created_at DESC LIMIT 12
  ) x
),
biz AS (SELECT to_jsonb(b) AS b FROM business b LIMIT 1),
svc AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('nombre', s.name, 'duracion_min', s.duration_minutes, 'precio', s.price) ORDER BY s.name) AS items
  FROM services s WHERE s.active
),
pro AS (
  SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
    'nombre', p.name,
    'servicios', (SELECT json_agg(s2.name) FROM professional_services ps JOIN services s2 ON s2.id = ps.service_id WHERE ps.professional_id = p.id)
  ) ORDER BY p.name) AS items
  FROM professionals p WHERE p.active
)
SELECT
  (SELECT id FROM cli) AS client_id,
  (SELECT phone FROM cli) AS phone,
  (SELECT name FROM cli) AS client_name,
  (SELECT opted_out FROM cli) AS opted_out,
  (SELECT consent_shown_at FROM cli) AS consent_shown_at,
  (SELECT id FROM conv) AS conversation_id,
  (SELECT state FROM conv) AS conversation_state,
  (SELECT summary FROM conv) AS conversation_summary,
  (SELECT items FROM hist) AS history,
  (SELECT b FROM biz) AS business,
  (SELECT items FROM svc) AS services,
  (SELECT items FROM pro) AS professionals;

INSERT INTO runs (conversation_id, inbound_messages, model_used, tokens_in, tokens_out, tools_called, response_text, total_latency_ms, error)
VALUES ($1::uuid, $2::jsonb, $3, $4::int, $5::int, $6::jsonb, $7, $8::int, $9);

options.queryReplacement:
={{ [
  $('Construir waPayload').item.json.conversationId,
  JSON.stringify($('Construir contexto modelo').item.json.buffer || []),
  '__MODEL_PROVIDER__/__MODEL_NAME__',
  $('Modelo · Normalizar').isExecuted ? (($('Modelo · Normalizar').item.json.usage || {}).in || 0) : 0,
  $('Modelo · Normalizar').isExecuted ? (($('Modelo · Normalizar').item.json.usage || {}).out || 0) : 0,
  JSON.stringify($('Modelo · Normalizar').isExecuted ? ($('Modelo · Normalizar').item.json.toolCalls || []) : []),
  $('Construir waPayload').item.json.finalText,
  0,
  $('Construir waPayload').item.json.handoff ? 'handoff' : null
] }}
